title: C97net qEngine CMS through 6.0.0, Kemana Directory through 1.5.6, Cart Engine through 3.0.0 Local File Inclusion via admin/task.php
desc: C97net qEngine CMS through 6.0.0, Kemana Directory through 1.5.6, and Cart Engine through 3.0.0 contain a local file inclusion vulnerability in the run parameter of admin/task.php. xfrm: policy: fix metadata dst->dev xmit null pointer dereference

== NULL) through xfrm interface we can hit a null pointer dereference[1]

loopback skb device when there's no policy which de

title: kprobes: don't call disarm_kprobe() for disabled kprobes
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

kprobes: don't call disarm_kprobe() for disabled kprobes

The assumption in __disable_kprobe() is wrong, and it could try to disarm
an already disarmed kprobe and fire the WARN_ONCE() below. [0]  We can
easily reproduce this issue.

title: powerpc/64: Init jump labels before parse_early_param()
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

powerpc/64: Init jump labels before parse_early_param()

On 64-bit, calling jump_label_init() in setup_feature_keys() is too
late because static keys may be used in subroutines of
parse_early_param() which is again subroutine of early_init_devtree().

For example booting with "threadirqs":

  static_key_enable_cpuslocked(): stati

title: ext4: avoid resizing to a partial cluster size
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ext4: avoid resizing to a partial cluster size

This patch avoids an attempt to resize the filesystem to an
unaligned cluster boundary.  An online resize to a size that is not
integral to cluster size results in the last iteration attempting to
grow the fs by a negative amount, which trips a BUG_ON and leaves the fs
with a corrup

title: ext4: block range must be validated before use in ext4_mb_clear_bb()
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ext4: block range must be validated before use in ext4_mb_clear_bb()

Block range to free is validated in ext4_free_blocks() using
ext4_inode_block_valid() and then it's passed to ext4_mb_clear_bb().
However in some situations on bigalloc file system the range might be
adjusted after the validation in ext4_free_blocks() which can

title: cxl: Fix a memory leak in an error handling path
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

cxl: Fix a memory leak in an error handling path

A bitmap_zalloc() must be balanced by a corresponding bitmap_free() in the
error handling path of afu_allocate_irqs().

title: net: genl: fix error path memory leak in policy dumping
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net: genl: fix error path memory leak in policy dumping

If construction of the array of policies fails when recording
non-first policy we need to unwind.

netlink_policy_dump_add_policy() itself also needs fixing as
it currently gives up on error without recording the allocated
pointer in the pstate pointer.

title: net: fix potential refcount leak in ndisc_router_discovery()
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net: fix potential refcount leak in ndisc_router_discovery()

The issue happens on specific paths in the function. After both the
object `rt` and `neigh` are grabbed successfully, when `lifetime` is
nonzero but the metric needs change, the function just deletes the
route and set `rt` to NULL. Then, it may try grabbing `rt` and `n

title: powerpc/pci: Fix get_phb_number() locking
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

powerpc/pci: Fix get_phb_number() locking

The recent change to get_phb_number() causes a DEBUG_ATOMIC_SLEEP
warning on some systems:

  BUG: sleeping function called from invalid context at kernel/locking/mutex.c:580
  in_atomic(): 1, irqs_disabled(): 0, non_block: 0, pid: 1, name: swapper
  preempt_count: 1, expected: 0
  RCU n

title: ASoC: SOF: debug: Fix potential buffer overflow by snprintf()
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ASoC: SOF: debug: Fix potential buffer overflow by snprintf()

snprintf() returns the would-be-filled size when the string overflows
the given buffer size, hence using this value may result in the buffer
overflow (although it's unrealistic).

This patch replaces with a safer version, scnprintf() for papering
over such a potential

title: octeontx2-af: Fix mcam entry resource leak
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

octeontx2-af: Fix mcam entry resource leak

The teardown sequence in FLR handler returns if no NIX LF
is attached to PF/VF because it indicates that graceful
shutdown of resources already happened. But there is a
chance of all allocated MCAM entries not being freed by
PF/VF. Hence free mcam entries even in case of detached LF.

title: virtio_net: fix memory leak inside XPD_TX with mergeable
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

virtio_net: fix memory leak inside XPD_TX with mergeable

When we call xdp_convert_buff_to_frame() to get xdpf, if it returns
NULL, we should check if xdp_page was allocated by xdp_linearize_page().
If it is newly allocated, it should be freed here alone. Just like any
other "goto err_xdp".

title: net: atlantic: fix aq_vec index out of range error
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net: atlantic: fix aq_vec index out of range error

The final update statement of the for loop exceeds the array range, the
dereference of self->aq_vec[i] is not checked and then leads to the
index out of range error.
Also fixed this kind of coding style in other for loop.

[   97.937604] UBSAN: array-index-out-of-bounds in drive

title: mptcp: move subflow cleanup in mptcp_destroy_common()
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mptcp: move subflow cleanup in mptcp_destroy_common()

If the mptcp socket creation fails due to a CGROUP_INET_SOCK_CREATE
eBPF program, the MPTCP protocol ends-up leaking all the subflows:
the related cleanup happens in __mptcp_destroy_sock() that is not
invoked in such code path.

Address the issue moving the subflow sockets cl

title: net: tap: NULL pointer derefence in dev_parse_header_protocol when skb->dev is null
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net: tap: NULL pointer derefence in dev_parse_header_protocol when skb->dev is null

Fixes a NULL pointer derefence bug triggered from tap driver.
When tap_get_user calls virtio_net_hdr_to_skb the skb->dev is null
(in tap.c skb->dev is set after the call to virtio_net_hdr_to_skb)
virtio_net_hdr_to_skb calls dev_parse_header_proto

desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

tee: add overflow check in register_shm_helper()

With special lengths supplied by user space, register_shm_helper() has
an integer overflow when calculating the number of pages covered by a
supplied user space memory region.

pin_user_pages_fast() to do a NULL point

title: mm/damon/reclaim: fix potential memory leak in damon_reclaim_init()
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm/damon/reclaim: fix potential memory leak in damon_reclaim_init()

damon_reclaim_init() allocates a memory chunk for ctx with
damon_new_ctx().  When damon_select_ops() fails, ctx is not released,
which will lead to a memory leak.

We should release the ctx with damon_destroy_ctx() when damon_select_ops()
fails to fix the memory

title: locking/csd_lock: Change csdlock_debug from early_param to __setup
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

locking/csd_lock: Change csdlock_debug from early_param to __setup

The csdlock_debug kernel-boot parameter is parsed by the
early_param() function csdlock_debug().  If set, csdlock_debug()
invokes static_branch_enable() to enable csd_lock_wait feature, which
triggers a panic on arm64 for kernels built with CONFIG_SPARSEMEM=y and

title: sched, cpuset: Fix dl_cpu_busy() panic due to empty cs->cpus_allowed
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

sched, cpuset: Fix dl_cpu_busy() panic due to empty cs->cpus_allowed

With cgroup v2, the cpuset's cpus_allowed mask can be empty indicating
that the cpuset will just use the effective CPUs of its parent. So
cpuset_can_attach() can call task_can_attach() with an empty mask.
This can lead to cpumask_any_and() returns nr_cpu_ids ca

title: powerpc/xive: Fix refcount leak in xive_get_max_prio
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

powerpc/xive: Fix refcount leak in xive_get_max_prio

of_find_node_by_path() returns a node pointer with
refcount incremented, we should use of_node_put() on it when done.
Add missing of_node_put() to avoid refcount leak.

title: cifs: Fix memory leak when using fscache
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

cifs: Fix memory leak when using fscache

If we hit the 'index == next_cached' case, we leak a refcount on the
struct page.  Fix this by using readahead_folio() which takes care of
the refcount for you.

title: mfd: max77620: Fix refcount leak in max77620_initialise_fps
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mfd: max77620: Fix refcount leak in max77620_initialise_fps

of_get_child_by_name() returns a node pointer with refcount
incremented, we should use of_node_put() on it when not need anymore.
Add missing of_node_put() to avoid refcount leak.

title: watchdog: sp5100_tco: Fix a memory leak of EFCH MMIO resource
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

watchdog: sp5100_tco: Fix a memory leak of EFCH MMIO resource

Unlike release_mem_region(), a call to release_resource() does not
free the resource, so it has to be freed explicitly to avoid a memory
leak.

desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

powerpc/perf: Optimize clearing the pending PMI and remove WARN_ON for PMI check in power_pmu_disable

commit 2c9ac51b850d ("powerpc/perf: Fix PMU callbacks to clear
pending PMI before resetting an overflown PMC") added a new
function "pmi_irq_pending" in hw_irq.h. This function is to check
if there is a PMI marked as pending in

title: RDMA/rxe: Fix error unwind in rxe_create_qp()
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

RDMA/rxe: Fix error unwind in rxe_create_qp()

In the function rxe_create_qp(), rxe_qp_from_init() is called to
initialize qp, internally things like the spin locks are not setup until
rxe_qp_init_req().

rxe_cleanup() and eventually to rxe_qp_do_cleanup()/rxe_cleanu

title: staging: fbtft: core: set smem_len before fb_deferred_io_init call
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

staging: fbtft: core: set smem_len before fb_deferred_io_init call

The fbtft_framebuffer_alloc() calls fb_deferred_io_init() before
initializing info->fix.smem_len.  It is set to zero by the
framebuffer_alloc() function.  It will trigger a WARN_ON() at the
start of fb_deferred_io_init() and the function will not do anything.

title: RDMA/hfi1: fix potential memory leak in setup_base_ctxt()
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

RDMA/hfi1: fix potential memory leak in setup_base_ctxt()

setup_base_ctxt() allocates a memory chunk for uctxt->groups with
hfi1_alloc_ctxt_rcv_groups(). When init_user_ctxt() fails, uctxt->groups
is not released, which will lead to a memory leak.

when init_us

title: RDMA/rxe: Fix BUG: KASAN: null-ptr-deref in rxe_qp_do_cleanup
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

RDMA/rxe: Fix BUG: KASAN: null-ptr-deref in rxe_qp_do_cleanup

The function rxe_create_qp calls rxe_qp_from_init. If some error
occurs, the error handler of function rxe_qp_from_init will set
both scq and rcq to NULL.

rxe_qp_do_cleanup is called by rxe_put. rxe_qp_do_cle

title: intel_th: msu: Fix vmalloced buffers
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

intel_th: msu: Fix vmalloced buffers

After commit f5ff79fddf0e ("dma-mapping: remove CONFIG_DMA_REMAP") there's
a chance of DMA buffer getting allocated via vmalloc(), which messes up
the mmapping code:

> RIP: msc_mmap_fault [intel_th_msu]
> Call Trace:
>  <TASK>
>  __do_fault
>  do_fault
...

Fix this by accounting for vmalloc

title: intel_th: Fix a resource leak in an error handling path
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

intel_th: Fix a resource leak in an error handling path

If an error occurs after calling 'pci_alloc_irq_vectors()',
'pci_free_irq_vectors()' must be called as already done in the remove
function.

title: soundwire: revisit driver bind/unbind and callbacks
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

soundwire: revisit driver bind/unbind and callbacks

In the SoundWire probe, we store a pointer from the driver ops into
the 'slave' structure. This can lead to kernel oopses when unbinding
codec drivers, e.g. with the following sequence to remove machine
driver and codec driver.

/sbin/modprobe -r snd_soc_sof_sdw
/sbin/modprobe

desc:

of: check previous kernel's ima-kexec-buffer against memory bounds

Presently ima_get_kexec_buffer() doesn't check if the previous kernel's
ima-kexec-buffer lies outside the addressable memory range. This can result

desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

Bluetooth: When HCI work queue is drained, only queue chained work

The HCI command, event, and data packet processing workqueue is drained
to avoid deadlock in commit
76727c02c1e1 ("Bluetooth: Call drain_workqueue() before resetting state").

workqueue. Whic

desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net: hinic: avoid kernel hung in hinic_get_stats64()

When using hinic device as a bond slave device, and reading device stats
of master bond device, the kernel may hung.

The kernel panic calltrace as follows:

title: drm/mcde: Fix refcount leak in mcde_dsi_bind
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/mcde: Fix refcount leak in mcde_dsi_bind

Every iteration of for_each_available_child_of_node() decrements
the reference counter of the previous node. There is no decrement
when break out from the loop and results in refcount leak.
Add missing of_node_put() to fix this.

desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

Syzbot reported use-after-free Read in ath9k_hif_usb_rx_cb() [0]. The

  ath9k_htc_wait_for_target()

title: ath11k: fix missing skb drop on htc_tx_completion error
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ath11k: fix missing skb drop on htc_tx_completion error

On htc_tx_completion error the skb is not dropped. This is wrong since
the completion_handler logic expect the skb to be consumed anyway even
when an error is triggered. Not freeing the skb on error is a memory
leak since the skb won't be freed anywere else. Correctly free

title: regulator: of: Fix refcount leak bug in of_get_regulation_constraints()
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

regulator: of: Fix refcount leak bug in of_get_regulation_constraints()

We should call the of_node_put() for the reference returned by
of_get_child_by_name() which has increased the refcount.

title: cpufreq: zynq: Fix refcount leak in zynq_get_revision
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

cpufreq: zynq: Fix refcount leak in zynq_get_revision

of_find_compatible_node() returns a node pointer with refcount
incremented, we should use of_node_put() on it when done.
Add missing of_node_put() to avoid refcount leak.

title: selinux: fix memleak in security_read_state_kernel()
desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

selinux: fix memleak in security_read_state_kernel()

In this function, it directly returns the result of __security_read_policy
without freeing the allocated memory in *data, cause memory leak issue,
so free the memory if __security_read_policy failed.

desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ARM: OMAP2+: display: Fix refcount leak bug

In omapdss_init_fbdev(), of_find_node_by_name() will return a node
pointer with refcount incremented. We should use of_node_put() when
it is not used anymore.

The driver use the non-managed form of the register function in

If device_register() fails in cxl_pci_afu|adapter(), the device

Can not set the @shared_hcd to NULL before decrease the usage count

desc: A flaw was found in the clevis PKCS#11 pin. The clevis-pkcs11-afunix-socket-unlock daemon logs LUKS disk encryption passphrases in plaintext to a log file. desc: A flaw was found in the clevis PKCS#11 pin. The clevis-pkcs11-afunix-socket-unlock daemon creates AF_UNIX sockets without explicit permission restrictions or peer credential verification. title: Clevis: clevis: pkcs#11 token pin written to world-readable file
desc: A flaw was found in the clevis PKCS#11 pin. The clevis-luks-pkcs11-askpin script writes the PKCS#11 token PIN in plaintext to a file without setting restrictive permissions. Under the default process umask, the file is world-readable. Additionally, the PIN file is not reliably cleaned up if the decryption script exits early, leaving the PIN accessible indefinitely.

title: Clevis: clevis: pkcs#11 token pin exposed on command line via pkcs11-tool
desc: A flaw was found in the clevis PKCS#11 pin. The clevis-decrypt-pkcs11 script passes the PKCS#11 token PIN as a command-line argument to pkcs11-tool, making it visible to any local user through process listing or the /proc filesystem.

Due to the lack of server-side session destruction, an attacker can ignore the logout redirect and keep the session alive. This may allow an attacker who obtains user's password to e.g. brute force the second-factor code.




This issue was fixed in commit 4640889.

The twofactor_gauthenticator plugin for Roundcube is vulnerable to 2fa authentication bypass by spoofed client address headers. Due to the lack of validation of the Client-IP and X-Forwarded-For headers, an attacker who obtains user's password can spoof a whitelisted IP address, resulting in the second factor being bypassed.

Some contexts may not properly account for this scenario and leave request memory in an uninitialized state before performing an allocation. desc: PHP has various global state that temporarily points into request memory. In some scenarios, global state may not be correctly reset, or may be repopulated after being reset. The global state may then refer to request memory even after it has been freed. Subsequent requests may read or branch on this stale state before it is fully initialized. desc:

title: Gnome-remote-desktop: busy-wait dos in vnc tls i/o handlers (gnutls_e_again / gnutls_e_interrupted)
desc: A flaw was found in gnome-remote-desktop as shipped in Red Hat Enterprise Linux. In the VNC TLS I/O handlers, retryable GnuTLS results (GNUTLS_E_AGAIN and GNUTLS_E_INTERRUPTED) are handled with an unbounded busy loop instead of yielding to the event loop. title: GROWI contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in its tag update API and the page update API due to improper use o
desc: GROWI contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in its tag update API and the page update API due to improper use of a user-controlled key. By exploiting this vulnerability, an attacker who can log in to the product may obtain the contents of pages without the required read permission and save them to pages that the attacker can edit.

title: Remote unauthenticated information disclosure and denial of service due to unauthenticated service access
desc:
A misconfiguration issue in the affected service in Control-M/Enterprise Manager and Control-M/Server may allow unauthenticated remote users to access certain service functionality, which could potentially result in information exposure or affect service availability.

desc:
Zephyr's native TCP stack iterates the global connection list in net_tcp_foreach() (subsys/net/ip/tcp.c) using the SYS_SLIST_FOR_EACH_CONTAINER_SAFE macro, which caches a pointer to the next list node. Prior to this fix the function released tcp_lock while invoking the per-connection callback and re-acquired it afterwards.

desc: In Zephyr's IPv4 IGMP implementation, igmp_send() in subsys/net/ip/igmp.c read the network interface back out of the packet via net_pkt_iface(pkt) after the packet had been handed to net_send_data(). title: Kirki WordPress Plugin < 6.2.5 reCAPTCHA Bypass via Missing Token
desc: Kirki plugin for WordPress before 6.2.5 contains a reCAPTCHA bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to submit frontend forms without valid verification by omitting the g-recaptcha-token field from POST requests to the form submission endpoint. Attackers can exploit the verify() method's early return on empty token values to submit unlimited forms, triggering notification emails

title: Vvveb: Authenticated IDOR on admin/auth-token Allows Admin Privilege Escalation via API Token Theft
desc: Vvveb is a powerful and easy to use CMS with page builder to build websites, blogs or ecommerce stores. Prior to version 1.0.8.7, authenticated IDOR on admin/auth-token endpoint allows any administrator to read and overwrite another administrator's API tokens. This issue has been patched in version 1.0.8.7.

title: Zuke: Command-form registry descriptors bypass the MCP launch policy
desc: Zuke is a code-first, strongly typed build automation system for Deno. Prior to 1.51.0, the @zuke/core MCP registry mode accepts command-form registry descriptors without applying the ZUKE_REGISTRY_LAUNCH_HOSTS authorization enforced for remote module descriptors. title: zuke setup and zuke import follow symbolic links planted at scaffold names, allowing writes outside the target directory
desc: Zuke is a code-first, strongly typed build automation system for Deno. Prior to 1.4.0, @zuke/cli uses lstat to inspect scaffold names but then performs link-following reads, writes, and permission changes in zuke setup and zuke import. An attacker who supplies an untrusted cloned repository, template, or archive with a symbolic link at a scaffolded name can cause setup to overwrite a target outsid

title: Wekan: ReDoS via Unescaped User Input in RegExp
desc: Wekan is open source kanban built with Meteor. Prior to 11.11, the user-search publication in server/publications/users.js and the searchUsers method in server/models/users.js pass authenticated user-controlled searchTerm and query values to new RegExp() without escaping regular-expression metacharacters. MongoDB-backed deployments evaluate the resulting patterns with PCRE2, allowing a logged-in u

title: Jellyfin through 12.4 Information Disclosure via GET /Playlists/{playlistId}
desc: Jellyfin through 12.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in PlaylistsController.GetPlaylist that allows authenticated users to read hidden item IDs by requesting public or shared playlists. Restricted or parental-controlled users can obtain GUIDs of inaccessible library items from unfiltered playlist ItemIds and then stream that hidden media.

title: Moodle through 5.3.0, 5.2.4, 5.1.8, 5.0.11 and 4.5.15 SQL Injection via enrol_database Course idnumber
desc: Moodle 5.3.0, 5.2.0 through 5.2.4, 5.1.0 through 5.1.8, 5.0.0 through 5.0.11, and through 4.5.15 contain an sql injection vulnerability in the External database enrolment plugin via course idnumber. Editing teachers can store a backslash-quote payload in idnumber that executes during scheduled sync on MySQL/MariaDB external databases, reading data and manipulating enrolment results.

title: OpenCart through 4.1.0.4 Payment Bypass via Free Checkout Reward Points
desc: OpenCart through 4.1.0.4 contains a business logic vulnerability that allows logged-in customers to place unpaid full-price orders by clearing reward points after selecting Free Checkout. Attackers can apply points, save Free Checkout, then submit zero points via reward.save so the confirm handler advances the order to Free Checkout status without payment.

title: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 SQL Injection via Central Columns col_extra and col_attribute
desc: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject SQL by supplying unescaped col_extra and col_attribute values to /database/central-columns. Attackers can inject SQL into pma__central_columns INSERT and UPDATE queries run with controluser privileges, reading or modifying other users' configuration-storage data.

title: Prometheus through 3.15.1 Credential Leak via remote_write Cross-Host Redirects
desc: Prometheus through 3.15.1 contains a credential leak vulnerability that allows attackers to capture Azure AD or Google IAM bearer tokens by redirecting remote_write requests to another host. Attackers controlling the remote-write endpoint or a redirecting server can return a 3xx to their host and replay the token, for example to write metrics to the victim's backend.

title: Parse Server 9.7.0 before 9.10.5-alpha.10 Installation Update Misdirection via Installation ID
desc: Parse Server from 9.7.0 before 9.10.5-alpha.10 contains an authorization flaw that applies _Installation updates addressed by object ID to the installation named in the X-Parse-Installation-Id header. When protectedFieldsTriggerExempt is enabled, attackers knowing another installation's object ID can make a beforeSave trigger process that installation's protected fields while writing elsewhere.

title: ArcadeDB 26.8.1 before 26.10.2 SSRF via ALTER DATABASE LOAD CSV Block List
desc: ArcadeDB from 26.8.1 before 26.10.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users with updateDatabaseSettings to disable the LOAD CSV IP block list via ALTER DATABASE. Attackers can set arcadedb.opencypher.loadCsv.blockedIpRanges to an empty string, then issue LOAD CSV requests to read cloud metadata and internal loopback or private services.

title: SQLite before 3.54.0 Stack Exhaustion via countOfViewOptimization() in VALUES Clause
desc: SQLite before 3.54.0 contains a stack exhaustion vulnerability in countOfViewOptimization() that allows attackers to crash the host process via count(*) over a large multi-row VALUES clause. Attackers supplying SQL or a database file with a crafted view can trigger deeply nested TK_PLUS expressions whose recursive freeing in sqlite3ExprDeleteNN() exhausts the C stack, causing denial of service.

title: UNIT3D through 9.2.0 Private Playlist Disclosure via Playlist Zip Download
desc: UNIT3D through 9.2.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in PlaylistZipController::show that allows authenticated users to download other members' private playlists. Attackers can enumerate sequential playlist ids at the /playlist-zips/{playlist} endpoint to obtain zips of all torrents, disclosing private collection membership.

title: tcpflow through 1.6.1 Out-of-Bounds Read via TCP Demultiplexer Payload Length
desc: tcpflow through 1.6.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read process memory by sending packets with forged IP payload lengths. Attackers can inject crafted IPv4 or IPv6 TCP packets into captured traffic or pcap files to leak adjacent memory into reconstructed flow files or crash tcpflow.

title: RuoYi-Vue-Plus through 6.0.0 Data-Scope Bypass via /system/user/list/dept/{deptId}
desc: RuoYi-Vue-Plus through 6.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in SysUserServiceImpl.selectUserListByDept that allows authenticated users to read users of other departments. Users holding system:user:list under a department-restricted role can request GET /system/user/list/dept/{deptId} with any department id to obtain usernames, nicknames, account status, last login IP and time, and

title: HuLa-Server through 3.0.7 IDOR via /feed/del Moment Deletion
desc: HuLa-Server through 3.0.7 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in FeedController.delFeed that allows authenticated users to delete other users' moments by supplying arbitrary feedId values. Attackers can send POST requests to /feed/del with another user's feedId to delete their moments along with associated media, comments, and likes.

title: CoreShop through 1.5.5 SQL Injection via order Parameter in GetGoodsPageList
desc: CoreShop through 1.5.5 contains an unauthenticated sql injection vulnerability in the api/Good/GetGoodsPageList endpoint via the unvalidated order parameter appended to ORDER BY. Attackers can inject subqueries that bypass SqlSugar's field check and use boolean-based or time-based blind techniques to extract member accounts and orders.

title: Blossom through 1.17.1 Authorization Bypass via Folder Endpoints
desc: Blossom through 1.17.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to access other users' folders because FolderService queries filter only on folder id. Attackers can supply another user's folder id to /folder/info, /folder/upd, /folder/open or /folder/del to read storage paths, rename, toggle visibility, or delete folders.

title: Tamery (Conar) 0.32.0 before 0.99.0 Broken Authorization via connectionsResources.create
desc: Tamery (formerly Conar) 0.32.0 before 0.99.0 contains a broken authorization vulnerability in the cloud sync API connectionsResources.create handler that allows authenticated users to attach resources to other users' connections. Attackers owning one connection can include a victim's connectionId in a batch request to insert attacker-named resource rows listed by the victim's client.

title: WPGraphQL Smart Cache before 2.3.3 Unbounded Persisted Query Storage DoS
desc: WPGraphQL Smart Cache before 2.3.3 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to persist unlimited query documents via the Automatic Persisted Query handler. Attackers can send distinct queries with matching SHA-256 queryId values, including batched operations, to grow the wp_posts table without bound and degrade database performance.

title: xiaozhi-esp32-server through 0.9.8 Authentication Bypass via Spoofed Device-ID Header
desc: xiaozhi-esp32-server through 0.9.8 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in WebSocketServer._handle_auth that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to skip Bearer HMAC token verification by spoofing the Device-ID header. Attackers supplying an allowlisted MAC-address-shaped device identifier can open an authenticated WebSocket session, issue voice-assistant commands, exchange audio, an

title: SonicJS through 3.0.0 Missing Authorization in Content Write API
desc: SonicJS through 3.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the /api/:collection and /api/content write routes that only check coarse role labels. Authenticated authors or editors can use a bearer JWT or API key to create, modify, publish, or soft-delete other users' documents, bypassing document ACLs and administrator deny overrides.

title: PipesHub before 0.10.0 Rate Limit Bypass via Spoofed X-Forwarded-For Header
desc: PipesHub before 0.10.0 contains a rate limit bypass vulnerability in getClientIp() that allows unauthenticated attackers to evade per-IP throttling by spoofing X-Forwarded-For or X-Real-IP headers. Attackers can rotate header values to obtain fresh rate-limit buckets on authentication endpoints, enabling password spraying and OTP or password-reset email flooding.

title: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 Clickjacking via Missing Frame-Control Headers
desc: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a clickjacking vulnerability that allows any origin to frame the authenticated interface because no X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors headers are sent. Attackers can overlay a signed-in user's session from a malicious page, tricking clicks that modify or delete records, change sharing settings, or invite collaborators.

title: Blender before 4.5.15 and 5.x before 5.2.3 Heap Buffer Overflow via Thumbnail Extraction
desc: Blender before 4.5.15 and 5.x before 5.2.3 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the blend file thumbnail extractor caused by 32-bit integer overflow in thumb_data_vertical_flip(). title: Chamilo LMS: Stored XSS in public user-profile fields
desc: Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. From 2.0.0 until 2.0.1, `GET /user/{username}` is anonymously reachable and renders six user-editable profile fields (`firstname`, `lastname`, `competences`, `openarea`, `teach`, and `diplomas`) inside `{% autoescape false %}`, without server-side sanitization on the write path. title: libass: Out-of-bounds bit clears for negative Matroska ReadOrder values
desc: libass is a portable subtitle renderer for the ASS/SSA (Advanced Substation Alpha/Substation Alpha) subtitle format. From 0.17.4 until 0.17.5, libass event pruning does not guard negative Matroska `ReadOrder` values, allowing an attacker to clear arbitrarily many bits to zero at attacker-controlled positions near the NULL pointer. title: Frappe LMS: Quiz result manipulation and cross-user submission forgery
desc: Frappe Learning Management System (LMS) is a learning system that helps users structure their content. Prior to version 2.54.0, quiz submission records are not adequately authorized on the server. Through a `REST` bypass, an authenticated student can record a passing or perfect quiz result without their answers being verified, unlocking course completion and certificates. title: WordPress myCred plugin <= 4.0.2 - Broken Access Control vulnerability
desc: Missing Authorization vulnerability in myCred myCred mycred allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects myCred: from n/a through 4.0.2.

title: Improper link resolution before file access in cPanel allows remote authenticated users to write arbitrary root-owned fi
desc: Improper link resolution before file access in cPanel allows remote authenticated users to write arbitrary root-owned files and escalate privileges.

title: Insecure permissions in lz233 Tarnhelm v1.8.2 (versionCode 20250630) allows unauthorized attackers to invoke an exported
desc: Insecure permissions in lz233 Tarnhelm v1.8.2 (versionCode 20250630) allows unauthorized attackers to invoke an exported component, leading to arbitrary data access and overwriting.

title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Alosuite that affects the delivery note functionality.
desc: A stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Alosuite that affects the delivery note functionality. Insufficient sanitization and encoding of the specified fields allow JavaScript to be stored, which executes in other users’ browsers when they view the affected records.
